title: BitBot and the Spark City Quest

chapters.title: The Spark City Signal
chapters.scene: BitBot discovers a mysterious signal coming from Spark City. The city needs an Explorer who can make smart money decisions.

choices.consequence: You learn that good decisions start with asking questions.

choices.text: Spend all your Spark Coins on gear
choices.consequence: You discover why saving some resources can help later.

chapters.title: The Market District
chapters.scene: At the Market District, BitBot finds food, a new game, and a backpack. You have limited Spark Coins.

choices.consequence: You identified a need before a want.

choices.text: Buy the game because it looks fun
choices.consequence: Fun can matter too, but now you have fewer coins for your goal.

chapters.title: The Quantum Budget
chapters.scene: The Quantum Lab needs your help. You have 30 Spark Coins. Choose how to spend, save, and protect your future goal.

choices.text: Save 15, spend 10, keep 5 for your goal
choices.consequence: Excellent! You created a balanced plan.
You learned that planning ahead gives you more choices later.
